newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade active in the panhandle area Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 27,400 head slaughter steers and 20,800 heifers; 74,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,900head formulated and 300 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 66.00-66.25, few North Plains 67.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 65.00. Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1200 lb Holsteins 60.00.
Slaughter Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 66.00-66.25, few North Plains 67.00. Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs including heiferettes 61.00-64.00.
Wk to Date: 74,700 Week Ago: 57,300 Year Ago: 13,800
